objects.query: SELECT Name, Status, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC
SELECT StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Name, IsActive, IsStandard, CostBookId, ValidFrom, ValidTo, Description FROM Pricebook2

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ProrationPolicyId, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModelOption ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType ASC

SELECT Name, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, CurrencyIsoCode, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
